    print(churn_by_col)

print("\n--- SQ2: Churn Rate by Contract/Payment/Billing Segments ---")
contract_cols = ['Contract', 'PaperlessBilling', 'PaymentMethod']
for col in contract_cols:
    print(f"\nChurn Rate by {col}:")
    churn_by_col = df.groupby(col)['Churn_numeric'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
    churn_by_col.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate', 'count': 'segment_size'}, inplace=True)
    print(churn_by_col)

print(numeric_by_churn)

]

    print(churn_by_col)

# Prepare data for modeling

numerical_features = df_model.select_dtypes(include=['int64', 'float64']).columns

# One-Hot Encode categorical features
df_model_encoded = pd.get_dummies(df_model, columns=categorical_features, drop_first=True)

# Scale numerical features
scaler = StandardScaler()
df_model_encoded[numerical_features] = scaler.fit_transform(df_model_encoded[numerical_features])

# Define X and y
X = df_model_encoded
y = df['Churn_numeric']

# Add constant for statsmodels
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit Logistic Regression model
logit_model = sm.Logit(y, X).fit()

# Extract coefficients, p-values, and calculate odds ratios
results_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'coefficient': logit_model.params,
    'p_value': logit_model.pvalues
})
results_summary['odds_ratio'] = np.exp(results_summary['coefficient'])

# Filter for significant predictors
significant_predictors = results_summary[results_summary['p_value'] < 0.05].sort_values(by='odds_ratio', ascending=False)
